title: Audit Associate
summary: An audit associate checks a company's accounts and controls on behalf of auditors: vouching transactions, testing controls and recording the work in working papers. You work in a CA firm or Big 4 audit team under an audit senior, on statutory audits (the yearly audit required by law) and internal audits.
dailyDuties: Vouch and verify sampled transactions against documents
Walk through processes and test internal controls
Prepare working papers and lead schedules
Check financial statements against Ind AS and Schedule III
Raise audit queries with client finance teams
Draft audit observations for the audit senior

skills.expectation: Carry out statutory audit fieldwork: vouching, verification and substantive testing
Perform walkthroughs and test internal financial controls and processes
Prepare audit working papers and draft observations to firm standards
Apply Ind AS and Schedule III when reviewing financial statements
Check GST and TDS compliance during audits and tax audits
Use Excel for sampling, analytics and audit schedules
Explain queries and findings clearly to client finance teams
Use audit and data-analytics tools such as CaseWare IDEA
Run ratio and trend analysis as analytical review
Review ledger and balance sheet reconciliations
Work directly in clients' Tally or similar accounting packages
Coordinate with client teams and seniors to close audits on time
